item.title: Open Source dependencies in software projects
item.description:
Most of the foundations of current commercial software projects are open source. But what happens when an open source project becomens unmaintained?

Dependencies, dependencies everywhere!

Most software projects have a miriad of depedendencies. Why? Because we (as software engineers) are not going to reinvent the wheel. Having your software depend on a well-tested, maintained, and supported is a bliss. It saves you time, and work very easily: you only have to be aware of two things:
